actionCalls.description: Queues a Google Calendar sync for this Booking Form (create/update the all-day event, or delete it if Cancelled). The actual callout happens later in its own async transaction.
actionCalls.name: Sync_to_Google_Calendar
actionCalls.label: Sync to Google Calendar

Flow.description: Creates/updates/deletes the Booking Form's event on the Artist's Google Calendar: New booking -> "{Town} - TBC", Confirmed/Completed -> "{Town}", Cancelled -> event deleted. Also re-syncs if Town, Date of Performance, End Date, or Artist changes later.
Flow.interviewLabel: Booking Form - RT - Sync Google Calendar {!$Flow.CurrentDateTime}
Flow.label: Booking Form - RT - Sync Google Calendar

start.filterFormula: OR( ISNEW(), ISCHANGED({!$Record.Stage__c}), ISCHANGED({!$Record.Town_or_City__c}), ISCHANGED({!$Record.Date_of_Performance__c}), ISCHANGED({!$Record.End_Date__c}), ISCHANGED({!$Record.Artist__c}))
